answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. A slot in the shared meadow needs a 300 POA deposit. Five peers audit the work within a 20-epoch horizon: a fake job burns the deposit, honest work returns it with the fee. A heartbeat signal proves the agent is live; an idle slot is released. Forging 100 identities burns 100 x 300 = 30,000 POA; an honest agent risks one deposit that comes back, so honest agents pay once, earnings undiluted.
